context.transcript:
Welcome to Weston Sports Stadium! We are very pleased
that you're joining us here for this special event. Tonight
is the first time our hometown baseball team is playing in
the regional championship! To celebrate, we'll be giving
away prizes throughout the night. Our first prize goes to
attendees who are in seats 23 through 30. They will each win
a free ticket to a game next season! We'll announce more
giveaways as tonight's game progresses. And don't forget
to stay after the game. There will be a fireworks display.
context.transcript_translation: 欢迎来到韦斯顿体育场！我们非常高兴各位前来参加这场特别活动。今晚是我们本地棒球队首次参加地区冠军赛！为此，我们整晚都会送出奖品。第一份奖品将送给座位号在 23 到 30 之间的观众，他们每人都会赢得一张下赛季比赛的免费门票！随着今晚比赛的进行，我们还会公布更多赠奖活动。别忘了赛后留下来，届时会有烟花表演。
